summary: End-to-end testing of Avex Cloud completed. All 27 backend pytest tests pass (auth, plans, servers, tickets, billing/Stripe checkout, admin CRUD, settings). Frontend pages render correctly: landing, all marketing pages, signup→/dashboard redirect, login→/admin redirect, user dashboard server creation, ticket creation, billing, account; admin panel users/plans/tickets/invoices/settings all load. First-user-is-admin behavior verified (new signup creates role=user). Free-tier limit (1 server) enforced. Stripe checkout produces a valid session URL.

ui_bugs.issue: Stat cards for Users / Servers / Open tickets show '—' (empty) on first load while Revenue/sub-labels show 0 — indicates the /api/admin/stats response did not populate the top-level numeric fields in the browser. Backend endpoint itself returns correct data (verified by pytest). Likely a race condition where component renders before fetch resolves, or values being 0 are rendering but other code path. Worth verifying with a forced refresh + network tab.
Post-signup success toast ('Account created. Check your email to verify.') visually overlaps the 'Get Help' button at the top right of the dashboard layout (z-index/positioning collision).
HTML document title is 'Emergent | Fullstack App' instead of 'Avex Cloud'. Update /app/frontend/public/index.html title and favicon.

issues: Toast notification overlaps 'Get Help' top-right action.

action_items: Investigate why AdminOverview shows '—' for Users/Servers/Open tickets stats while the backend endpoint returns correct values in pytest. Likely null-handling or fetch race in /app/frontend/src/pages/admin/AdminOverview.jsx.
Position toast container so it does not collide with the 'Get Help' button (z-index or top offset).
Update document <title> in /app/frontend/public/index.html to 'Avex Cloud' (currently 'Emergent | Fullstack App').
critical_code_review_comments: auth.py /register returns the user payload including `is_first_user` flag but does NOT strip `password_hash` — verified user model excludes it, but be cautious if model_dump ever includes extras.
servers.py free-tier limit logic: when user.role == 'admin' or 'staff', no limit. OK, but consider rate-limit safety.
billing.py: STRIPE_API_KEY falls back to 'sk_test_emergent' hardcoded default — acceptable given env is set, but consider failing fast if missing in production.
models.py User.email is EmailStr — good. Password hashing via bcrypt confirmed in auth_utils (verified via successful login round-trips).
All routes properly use `_id: 0` projection — no ObjectId leakage observed in any response.

context_for_next_testing_agent: Use BASE_URL https://avex-hosting.preview.emergentagent.com. Backend tests live at /app/backend/tests/backend_test.py and pass 27/27 in ~9s. Admin login firstadmin@avex.click / Admin12345!. The pytest suite is self-contained: it dynamically creates a new regular user each run so the 'first user becomes admin' invariant is not disturbed. Known UI issue: AdminOverview stat cards show '—' for Users/Servers/OpenTickets despite backend returning correct values — likely a frontend rendering issue (race condition or property mapping). Toast overlaps 'Get Help' button. Document title is still 'Emergent | Fullstack App'.
rca of the issue: AdminOverview '—' issue RCA hypothesis: in /app/frontend/src/pages/admin/AdminOverview.jsx, Stat receives `value={stats?.users}`. When stats is null (initial render or fetch failure), value=undefined → renders '—'. Sub labels use `|| 0` so they show 0 even when stats null, masking the failure. Need to confirm whether /admin/stats request succeeded by inspecting browser Network tab; if 401, it's a cookie/session boundary issue when navigating directly to /admin right after login.
